title: Do It Good
scene: Miami TK Records early disco and funk
notes: Punchy early Miami funk: whistles, brass, backing voices and spare, driving rhythms.

title: KC and the Sunshine Band
scene: Miami TK Records disco and funk
notes: Bright disco breakthrough with layered horns, guitar tape effects and commanding dance-floor hooks.

title: The Sound of Sunshine
notes: Instrumental Sunshine Band outing: syncopated guitar, brisk brass and rhythmic funk vamps.

title: Part 3
scene: Miami TK Records disco and funk
notes: A relentless horn-driven disco album, from Shake Your Booty to I’m Your Boogie Man.
